item.title: New crime data out of Fayetteville shows overall crime is down, violent crime is up
item.description: The department’s newly released 2025 crime report shows total crime dropped more than 7% between January and December compared to 2024. At first glance, the report appears promising, but a closer look reveals areas of concern.
